text:
Jia: Heads up — I'm about to ship a runtime config for `route_by_cost_v2` (more granular cost buckets + fallback). Want to make sure rollout plan covers quotas, telemetry gating, and a console emergency pause.
Sam: +1. Can we run it in preview/dry-run first and wire a telemetry gate that fails the rollout if error-rate or p50 latency regresses?
Ash: Question — route_by_cost changes routing decisions; could increase pressure on low-cost pools and blow their quotas. Need quota probe before traffic shift.
Jia: Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) dry-run mode for 24h capturing decision logs; 2) 2-hour canary at 1% traffic with telemetry sampling (5% detailed traces); 3) bump to 10% if no signals; 4) auto-rollforward to 50% unless circuit breaker trips.
Eva: UX note — console needs a single-click "emergency pause" that sets rollout to 0 and forces fallback model for matching routes. Also show quick health badge (OK / Degraded / Paused).
Sam: Implementation details: add a preview flag `config.preview.route_by_cost_v2 = true` that toggles dry-run. Telemetry gate checks: p50 latency delta < +30ms, error-rate < +0.1%, and routing distribution variance < 5%. If gate fails, mark rollout state `blocked` and notify #eng-oncall.
Ash: For quota probe we should run a synthetic traffic replay against the low-cost pools with a scaled multiplier equal to projected delta at 10% rollout. If replay shows >80% quota usage, block. I'll own the quota-replay job.
Jia: I'll add a preflight CI job that runs the replay and returns a `quota_ok` boolean. Example config snippet we can store in config-service: ```json
{
  "preview": true,
  "sampling_rate": 0.05,
  "canary_pct": 1,
  "telemetry_gate": {
    "p50_delta_ms": 30,
    "error_rate_delta": 0.001,
    "routing_variance_pct": 5
  }
}
```
Sam: Nice. Also add a dryrun collector for `routing_decisions` with anonymized keys — we need real histograms to compute variance. Keep retention 7d.
Eva: For the console pause button — can we reuse the existing "emergency-pause" API? If not, add a safe wrapper that logs who pressed it and requires two approvals for prod.
Jia: Let's require 2 approvals for Dedicated/Private prod; self-serve for dev/staging. Will wire audit events.
devex-bot: CI:preview-job for route_by_cost_v2 passed (sha: abc123) — replay job queued (owner: Ash).
ops-bot: FYI deploy window scheduled 03:00 UTC; will run dry-run deploy to preview cluster.
Sam: Action items: Sam -> implement telemetry gate + dryrun collector; Ash -> quota replay and probe automation; Jia -> preflight CI + rollout state machine; Eva -> console pause UX + approval flow.
Ash: I'll post the replay script and results in this thread when done.
Jia: I'll draft the rollback playbook: immediate pause, revert config to `route_by_cost_v1`, and trace for 5m windows. Will link runbook to console action.
Eva: I'll mock the pause UI and approval modal today, ping product for copy.
Sam: Sounds good. If we don't see issues in the 1% canary after 2 hours, proceed to 10% with the same telemetry checks. If gate trips at any point, automatic rollback to v1 and notify oncall. :thumbsup:
Jia: Thanks everyone — landing plan in the config repo in a PR by EOD.
